title: Towards Low-Resource Alignment to Diverse Perspectives with Sparse Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Jensen-Shannon (JS) distance between the language model's probability distribution over multiple-choice answers and the opinion distributions of specific regional or cultural demographics (e.g., Asian culture, European culture) using the GlobalOpinionQA dataset.

Evaluating the Jensen-Shannon (JS) distance between the model's generated opinion distributions and the survey responses of different political leanings (e.g., Reddit Left, Reddit Right, Reddit Center) on the GlobalOpinionQA dataset.

Comparing model predictions to granular, subjective feedback from individual domain experts and differing legal frameworks (e.g., human rights laws versus criminal offenses) using macro and micro F1 scores on Legal Hate Speech (LHS) and Misinformation (MisLC) datasets.
